description: FastAPI route handlers for managing notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, with database interactions via SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: _parse_sort
methods.description: Parses the sort query parameter into SQLAlchemy order_by expressions.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns a list of notes with optional search, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by ID.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and/or content.
